findings.one_line: The advertised matched/frontier kernel has been replaced by a theorem explicitly equivalent to the cited published d/n-to-d^2/n bracket; the capsule norm bound, scalable estimator, and sharper frontier all remain open, so this headline is not a novel theorem-level contribution.

The related-work discussion omits relevance/comparison sentences for several bibliography entries (including Aronow--Samii, Ugander--Yin, Karrer et al., Pippenger, Krivelevich et al., Kallus, and Narang et al.), so the retained headline is not fully positioned even as a benchmark note.
